name: Stone church
kicker: Stone church on the town square
summary: Stone church on the town square: spend about 60 minutes on the tower and the square, the pin in the center. The visit is free. Saturday evening the square holds the market gathering. The church is dated 1895, and also to the early 20th century. It is also called Đức Mẹ Mân Côi.
getThere: The town center. This is the pin.
heroCaption: The stone church and the square in the morning fog

notice.title: Ask at the door
notice.body: No reliable opening clock is posted. Ask when you arrive.

body: You come for the stone front, the tower, and the cross, and for the open square in front of them. The church stands on about 6,000 m², in a Roman Gothic form, with a bell tower of 20 m. A 1932 bell is about 1.5 m and 500 kg. The church is dated 1895, and also to the early 20th century. It is also called Đức Mẹ Mân Côi.

The square is where people meet. On Saturday evening the gathering is trading, singing, and talking, not a ticketed show. The evening has no fixed clock. Christmas is marked here without a civil date. The church is lit, and most parishioners gather to pray and sing.
The visit is free. Allow about 60 minutes. Ham Rong, the garden hill, is the walk behind the church.

figures.caption: The stone tower and the cross
figures.alt: The stone tower and cross of the Sa Pa church against a pale sky

gettingThere: The church is the center of town, inside phường Sa Pa after 1 July 2025. You are already there if you slept in the hub. Ham Rong is the park beside it, about 400–700 m on foot.

legs.heading: From a town hotel
legs.body: Walk. The church and the square are the center.

admissionNote: Free. Allow about 60 minutes. Saturday evening in the square has no ticket.
